name: CSO_DISCUSSION_BOARD
description: This table contains the discussion board records.

columns.name: ABUSE_THRESHOLD
columns.description: Number of abuse reports before taking action on the abusive message.

columns.name: BAN_IF_ABUSE
columns.description: Flag that indicates that the author should be banned if abuse threshold reached.

columns.name: BAN_USER_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days a user should be banned from the site.

columns.name: DATE_ADDED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was added to the repository.

columns.name: DATE_MODIFIED
columns.description: Datetime record was last modified in repository.

columns.name: ENABLE_ABUSE
columns.description: Flag that indicates if the report abuse functionality is turned on or not. Values 0-Disabled, 1-Enabled.

columns.name: HELPFUL_POINTS
columns.description: Number of points awarded to the message author for a helpful answer.

columns.name: HELPFUL_QUANTITY
columns.description: Number of helpful answers allowed for a topic question.

columns.name: MESSAGE_RATING_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to the survey record that represents the rating used for message records.

columns.name: OWNER_SITE_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to the site record that owns the discussion board.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: REFERENCE_KEY
columns.description: Locale independent name used to uniquely identify a discussion board.

columns.name: SOLVED_POINTS
columns.description: Number of points awarded to the message author for a solved answer.

columns.name: SOLVED_QUANTITY
columns.description: Number of solved answers allowed for a topic question.

columns.name: TOPIC_RATING_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to the survey record that represents the rating used for topic records.

columns.name: UNPUBLISH_IF_ABUSE
columns.description: Flag that indicates that the messages should be unpublished if abuse threshold reached.

columns.name: MODERATE_IF_ABUSE
columns.description: Flag that indicates that the messages should be flagged for moderation if abuse threshold reached.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: This is the obsolete GUID reference to the user that created the record.

columns.name: USER_NAME
columns.description: Full name of user record that created the record.

columns.name: USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This is the ID of the user that created the record.
